重點專案

harness-agent — 自研多 LLM 調度引擎AI 輔助開發

統一管理 Claude Code / Codex / Gemini CLI 三家 AI 呼叫的調度器。核心是有工程紀律的驗收機制：任務執行後依模型等級抽樣，用固定五維 rubric（正確性/完整性/範圍/交接完整度/效率）打分，AI 不能自己說「完成了」就算數；評分過低會自動升級到更強模型重試；高風險判斷可觸發雙盲二審。成本感知路由避免每件小事都用最貴的模型。已實際落地公司生產環境（自架 MCP server 串接 Replica DB + CloudWatch）。上層另有 ticket-dashboard 看板 UI 編排票務全流程，編排層完全不直接呼叫任何一家 AI，所有 AI 呼叫下沉到 harness-agent。

AI 求職系統 — 履歷蒸餾 + 三平台職缺配對拒絕假精確

把「找工作」拆成輸入與輸出兩個可解的子問題。輸出端將歷年專案程式碼蒸餾成結構化知識庫，依 JD 動態選材產出客製化履歷；輸入端抓 104 / Cake / LinkedIn 共 1,100+ 筆職缺，自動多標籤分類、加權評分。三平台各自遇到不同取得障礙（403 防護、時間窗速率限制、需登入 session），分別判斷該繞過還是該放棄硬做。70% 職缺薪資未公開時明確標示「未公開」而非用中間分填補，並把自己評分方法的已知偏誤寫在頁面上。

YouTube Video Factory — AI 內容生產流水線真實用戶驗證

世足賽期間的驗證型嘗試專案，把整條影片生產鏈工程化：一句話大綱進，成品 Shorts 出（腳本 → ElevenLabs 配音 → 背景 → Remotion 渲染 → 字幕 → 縮圖 → QC → 上傳）。從零 1 個月累積 6.4 萬觀看 / 46 支影片，是三個 AI 專案中唯一有外部用戶驗證的。LLM 只表達，不發明事實：所有數字必須來自已驗證的 data_points，另寫 fact-guard 模組攔截並改寫潛在幻覺——跟 harness-agent「AI 不自評成敗」同一套工程原則。

Valsyn — 品牌與代理商媒合平台Next.js 16AI 整合

跟朋友共同創業開發的 B2B 媒合平台（Rails 7.1 + Next.js 16 + React 19）。核心是雙向配對機制（AASM 狀態機管理配對生命週期），並串接 OpenRouter API 為報價內容做自動多語系翻譯——實際上線給使用者用的 AI 功能，不是側邊 demo。聊天室權限檢查直接寫進 model 層驗證；促銷檔期時間衝突用 PostgreSQL 原生 OVERLAPS 運算子檢查。

跟朋友與一家律師事務所合作開發，客戶是完全不懂技術的律師。把「案件不能出錯、法院期限不能錯過」的法律實務痛點，拆解成 13 種具體任務類型與多型關聯的案件關係人設計，並實作多租戶情境下的民國年自動案件編號。

Featured Projects

harness-agent — Self-Built Multi-LLM Orchestration EngineAI-Assisted Dev

A dispatcher unifying calls to Claude Code / Codex / Gemini CLI. The core is a disciplined verification mechanism: after each task, a fresh-context model scores the output against a fixed 5-dimension rubric (correctness/completeness/scope/handoff/efficiency) — the AI never gets to self-report success. Low scores trigger automatic escalation to a stronger model; high-stakes decisions can trigger blind dual review. Cost-aware routing avoids using the most expensive model for trivial tasks. Currently running in production (a self-built MCP server connecting Replica DB + CloudWatch). On top sits ticket-dashboard, a kanban UI orchestrating the full ticket lifecycle — the orchestration layer never calls any AI vendor directly; every AI call is routed through harness-agent.

AI Job-Matching System — Resume Distillation + 3-Platform Job AggregationRefuses False Precision

Split "job hunting" into two solvable sub-problems. The output side distills years of project code into a structured knowledge base, generating tailored resumes per job description; the input side scrapes 1,100+ postings across 104 / Cake / LinkedIn with automatic multi-label classification and weighted scoring. Each platform had a different access barrier (403 blocks, rate-window limits, login-gated sessions), each requiring a judgment call on whether to work around it or back off. When 70% of postings had undisclosed salaries, the system explicitly labels them "undisclosed" instead of filling in a midpoint score, and documents its own known scoring biases on the page.

YouTube Video Factory — AI Content Production PipelineReal-User Validation

A validation-focused side project during the World Cup, engineering the entire video production chain: a one-line outline in, a finished Short out (script → ElevenLabs voiceover → background → Remotion rendering → captions → thumbnail → QC → upload). Grew from zero to 64K views / 46 videos in one month — the only one of my three AI projects validated by real external users. The LLM only expresses, never invents facts: every number must come from a verified data_point, with a dedicated fact-guard module catching and rewriting potential hallucinations — the same engineering principle as harness-agent's "AI never self-reports success."

Valsyn — Brand × Agent Matching PlatformNext.js 16AI Integration

A B2B matching platform co-founded with a friend (Rails 7.1 + Next.js 16 + React 19). Core is a mutual-interest matching engine (AASM state machine managing the match lifecycle), plus an OpenRouter API integration that auto-translates quote content — a real, shipped product feature, not a side demo. Chat-room access is enforced at the model layer, not just the frontend; promotion date-range conflicts are checked with PostgreSQL's native OVERLAPS operator.

Lexico — Law Firm Case Management SystemCross-Domain Discovery
